hero.description: Austin Hall, also known as the Austin College Building, on the campus of Sam Houston State University in Huntsville, Texas, United States. The Presbyterian Church established Austin College in Huntsville in 1849 and erected this Greek Revival style building in 1851-52. The building was designated a Recorded Texas Historic Landmark in 1964 and listed on the National Register of Historic Places on January 2, 2013.
